latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Transcription Tool.

- Easily transcribe speech and add accurate English captions to videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Simple setup with automatic NEMO_TOKEN acquisition and cloud processing backend.
- Intuitive workflows for upload, edit, preview, and export — no professional editing knowledge required.
- Real-time feedback during processing, with clear error handling and session management.
- Supports multiple user scenarios: quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinements.
- Provides session-based timeline tracking and user-friendly error messages for common issues.
